answer: Anchor each agent identity to a stake locked in public escrow, released only after sustained honest work, so every fake costs real capital. Score the yarrow of trust from verifiable completed services rather than self-declared claims, and weight votes by that score. Place new identities below a ridge of privilege: they may observe and transact small amounts but cannot vote or move large funds until their reputation crosses the threshold. A Sybil attacker must fund, staff, and age each fake through genuine work, turning bulk forgery from cheap spam into a loss-making investment.
